title: llm.output payload
description: One call of the LLM gateway, recorded before the answer is used (data-model.md 7.2, contracts.md C-07 v1.2). The record key for a replay is (meta.correlation_id, meta.agent.id, phase, attempt), so correlation_id, agent, actor_kind, replay and gm_path live in meta and are not repeated here (ADR-007 p. 1). validation_status is the outcome of the pipeline; the reasons of a refusal belong to llm.output.rejected alone (ADR-017 addendum 1).

provider.description: The name from MV_LLM_PROVIDER, never an address. The pattern is the whole point: the field said 'a name and nothing else' in prose while accepting a URL, and this event lives in llm_records for the whole retention of the topic (T-215).

params.description: Sampling of the request (contracts.md C-15 v1.1). Recorded as sent, so that a replay reproduces the call.

prompt_hash.description: The prompt itself is kept in local storage behind a flag; the record carries the hash only (SEC-23).

reasons.description: Denormalised set of the reasons of the related llm.output.rejected, so that a report needs no join (C-07 v1.2).

parse.description: How the parser recovered the JSON of the answer (ADR-016 p. 1, C-07 v1.1).

reasoning_len.description: Length of the reasoning_content the gateway threw away (Response.ReasoningLen, C-15 v1.1). The length and nothing else: the reasoning text itself is never recorded (ADR-005 add. 2 p. 1).

error.description: Present when validation_status=error. code=yielded means a background call gave the queue up to a player turn (ADR-014 p. 2).

then.$comment: A text the filter blocked, and a text the filter could not judge, are both left unstored: the record keeps the hash and the length, and content.incident.recorded carries the fact without the text (C-07, orchestrator decision on OV-33).
